scope: 2026-10-22 retained all 47 MR40 LONG Bybit Spot BTCUSDT signal pairs, no new strategy optimization

precommitted_descriptive_metrics.trade_price_adverse_MAE_pct: max(0,-min_held_4h_low_relative_to_entry_open_pct). Compute only per-position; DO NOT confuse global equity-peak-to-low DD with entry-relative MAE.
precommitted_descriptive_metrics.nearest_rank_quantile: sort ascending and take 1-indexed ceil(p*n). No quantile interpolation.
precommitted_descriptive_metrics.cross_classification: For each duration bucket report n, number with price_MAE>=5%, >=10%, >=15%; descriptive only and NO evidence of causal effect of holding time.
precommitted_descriptive_metrics.early_adversity: For each selected position report earliest UTC four-hour OPEN of bar containing lowest LOW, and offset hours from entry to start of that bar. It does not prove when within the four-hour bar the low occurred.
precommitted_descriptive_metrics.worst_trade_listing: Top 5 positions ordered by descending adverse MAE, tie break ascending trade index; separately longest 5 by descending duration; all originally frozen dates.
precommitted_descriptive_metrics.always_report: Gross and fee-only realized PnL are historical Open-price proxies only; observed MAE and time-underwater independent of selection; no executable stops or fills.
precommitted_descriptive_metrics.risk_promotion_rule: Output ONLY a diagnostic decision state NO_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION: user-specific risk limit was never approved and true forward source/receipt latency + actual order execution not verified. Do not choose a stop or allocation rule based on this already seen sample.
